fusions.name: Dragged Under
fusions.desc: A hundred small paws drag down one enemy up to 4 tiles away that is at or below 25% health, dealing 24 damage, rising to 1.2 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Grasping Carpet
fusions.desc: Your swarm grabs at every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 11 damage and holding each stunned for 1 second.

fusions.name: Every Paw Helping
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 25% for 12 seconds. For 8 seconds, an escort of rats fights beside you, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Pilfered Ring
fusions.desc: Conjures a pilfered trinket: your critical chance rises by 5%, your critical hits deal 0.15x more, each kill returns 3 health, and your maximum health rises by 10.
